reason: The report has two procedural flaws: it omits the pre-period outcome (export_growth_2020) and trims 1% of the outcome. I re-ran the model on the full sample with export_growth_2020 and all the other pre-period controls, and the supplier_diversity coefficient stays positive and significant (about 0.69, SE 0.24, p<0.005). No control was measured after treatment, so the 'positive effect' conclusion holds.
